frontier_protocol.ponder.tag.containment: Create-powered infrastructure for suppressing Spore infection.
frontier_protocol.ponder.stabilizer_oper: Connect Create rotational power to the Stabilizer shaft.
Use Funnels, Chutes, Belts, or other Create logistics to insert Stabilization Cells into the machine.
At the configured RPM, a Cell starts an ACTIVE operating duration with suppression and progressive cleanup.
If rotation is lost, the machine enters GRACE_PERIOD. Suppression remains, but cleanup pauses.
When grace expires the machine becomes OFFLINE. Restore rotation while stored Cell time remains, or supply another Cell.
frontier_protocol.ponder.stabilizer_cove: Each tile represents one chunk, centered on the Stabilizer placement chunk.
Tier 1 covers 1x1, Tier 2 covers 3x3, and Tier 3 covers 5x5 chunks by default.
Coverage spans the full dimension height. If one overlapping Stabilizer stops, another source keeps shared chunks suppressed.
Suppression does not stop hostile mobs. Build walls, lighting, and physical defenses separately.
Initial Overworld spawn is a separate permanent 5x5 suppression source by default. It needs no Cell or rotation, performs no cleanup, and does not stop mobs.
frontier_protocol.ponder.stabilizer_prod: Mix 100 mB of TFMG Liquid Plastic with Sand, Blue Ice, and eight Iron Nuggets. No heat is required.
The unheated Mixing step produces one Stabilization Compound.
A powered Deployer presses Compound onto an Iron Sheet on a Depot.
Deploying produces one Stabilization Cell. Compound cannot power a Stabilizer directly.
A representative 3x3 Mechanical Crafter array produces the Tier 1 Stabilizer.
Mechanical Crafters then upgrade Tier 1 to Tier 2 and Tier 2 to Tier 3. Every tier uses the same Cell.
